item.text:
**3B.7 Research Note**

Overall read: Lula’s 2024 record shows real, if incomplete, protection of vulnerable groups through anti-hate rhetoric, anti-poverty measures, climate/deforestation enforcement, and tighter police-use rules. The main counterevidence is that police violence and prison abuse remained serious, so protection was partial rather than complete.

- [Discurso do presidente Lula no evento à margem da Assembleia Geral das Nações Unidas em defesa da democracia: lutando contra o extremismo](https://www.gov.br/g20/pt-br/documentos/discursos/discurso-do-presidente-lula-no-evento-a-margem-da-assembleia-geral-das-nacoes-unidas-em-defesa-da-democracia-lutando-contra-o-extremismo) — Governo do Brasil / G20 — 2024-09-24  
  - Claim-level summary: Lula explicitly condemned racist, xenophobic, misogynistic, and anti-minority narratives, and said extremists blame migrants, women, and minorities for current problems. This is direct evidence of protective rhetoric toward vulnerable groups.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.7; also 3B.3, 2B.6

- [Portaria MJSP nº 648, de 28 de maio de 2024](http://dspace.mj.gov.br/handle/1/12967) — Ministério da Justiça e Segurança Pública — 2024-05-28  
  - Claim-level summary: the justice ministry created national body-camera guidelines for public security agencies, emphasizing recording, transparency, evidence preservation, and tighter control of police conduct. This is a concrete anti-abuse measure that should especially protect marginalized communities that are most exposed to police violence.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.7; also 3B.6, 3B.5, 3B.4, 3B.1

- [Decreto que atualiza regras sobre o uso diferenciado da força pelas polícias é publicado](https://www.gov.br/mj/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/decreto-que-atualiza-regras-sobre-o-uso-diferenciado-da-forca-pelas-policias-e-publicado) — Ministério da Justiça e Segurança Pública — 2024-12-24  
  - Claim-level summary: Lula signed a decree updating police use-of-force rules and less-lethal instruments, framed around legality, precaution, necessity, due process, and non-discrimination. That is strong evidence of a rights-based effort to protect vulnerable people from abusive force.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.7; also 3B.6, 3B.5, 3B.4, 3B.1

- [2024 o ano do combate à fome e redução da pobreza](https://www.gov.br/mds/pt-br/noticias-e-conteudos/desenvolvimento-social/noticias-desenvolvimento-social/2024-o-ano-do-combate-a-fome-e-reducao-da-pobreza) — Ministério do Desenvolvimento Social — 2024-12-23  
  - Claim-level summary: the ministry said 24.4 million people left severe food insecurity and poverty fell to its lowest level since 2012. This is strong support for reducing systematic neglect of vulnerable populations, though it is official government reporting.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.7

- [Taxa de desmatamento na Amazônia cai 30,6% e 25,7% no Cerrado](https://www.gov.br/mma/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/taxa-de-desmatamento-na-amazonia-cai-30-6-e-25-7-no-cerrado) — Brazil Ministry of Environment and Climate Change / INPE — 2024-11-06  
  - Claim-level summary: official 2024 deforestation estimates fell sharply versus 2023, with the Amazon at its lowest level in nine years. Indirectly, this helps protect Indigenous, rural, and riverine communities from displacement, land pressure, and environmental neglect.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.7; also 2B.10

- [Decreto nº 12.006, de 24 de abril de 2024](https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2024/decreto/d12006.htm) — Presidência da República / Planalto — 2024-04-24  
  - Claim-level summary: school-violence reporting was integrated into national security information channels and an emergency number. This is a targeted administrative response that can help protect children and school communities from violence.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.7; also 3B.6, 3B.5

- [Brazil: Comply with Rulings on Police Violence](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/15/brazil-comply-rulings-police-violence) — Human Rights Watch — 2024-03-15  
  - Claim-level summary: HRW said Brazil still had not fully implemented independent-investigation requirements for police killings and that lethal raids, unlawful force, intimidation, and evidence tampering continued. This is strong counterevidence that vulnerable groups were still exposed to serious state violence.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.7; also 3B.6, 3B.5, 3B.4, 3B.1

- [World Report 2025: Brazil](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2025/country-chapters/brazil) — Human Rights Watch — 2025-01-01, covering 2024 events  
  - Claim-level summary: HRW reported continued police killings in 2024 and prison conditions marked by overcrowding and ill-treatment/torture in multiple states. That is the clearest evidence that protection systems were incomplete and that some vulnerable groups still faced serious abuse and neglect.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.7; also 3B.6, 3B.5, 3B.4, 3B.1

Search gap: I did not find strong 2024 evidence that Lula personally drove new targeted violence against women, children, minorities, migrants, or religious/ethnic groups. The strongest positive material is anti-discrimination rhetoric plus welfare, policing, and environmental measures; the strongest negative material is continued police/prison abuse rather than Lula-initiated targeted persecution.
